rule: each `old` occurs exactly once in the gate at REV; the counter replaces it with `new` in a copy inside a scratch clone, reruns the gate rows, and counts the mutant killed when a row that held before the edit differs after it

mutants.name: accept-on-drift
mutants.effect: a content-drifting receipt on a declared --paths surface is accepted (the drift branch never refuses)

mutants.name: wrong-refusal-code
mutants.effect: the drift branch refuses with RECEIPT_REV_MISMATCH instead of RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT

mutants.name: exit-0-on-unresolvable
mutants.effect: an unresolvable certified revision exits 0 instead of 2
